name: FlashAttention (FA1)
tagline: Single-pass tiled causal attention with online softmax — Dao et al.'s original FA1 algorithm in Triton.
pseudocode:
1. Wrapper: 64×64 BLOCK_M/BLOCK_N, grid = (cdiv(seq, 64), batch*heads).
2. Inside kernel: load Q tile, init m_i = -inf, l_i = 0, acc = 0.
3. For start_n in [0, hi): load K/V tile, compute $qk = (Q\cdot K^T)\cdot \text{sm\_scale}$.
4. Causal mask via tl.where every block; online softmax update $(m_i, l_i, \text{acc})$ using $\exp_2$ rescaling.
5. After loop, divide acc by l_i and store output tile.
diff_from_baseline: Dao, Fu, Ermon, Rudra & Ré, NeurIPS 2022 — FlashAttention. Reference fused tiled softmax+attention with online softmax; canonical single-pass causal Triton baseline.

name: FlashAttention-2 (FA2)
tagline: Two-pass causal split (no-mask blocks + boundary blocks), softmax scale fused into Q, per-headdim block sizes.
pseudocode:
1. Pre-multiply $Q \leftarrow Q \cdot (\text{sm\_scale} \cdot \log_2 e)$ in the wrapper to fuse scale + base-2 conversion.
2. Choose per-headdim tiles: 128×64 for hdim ≤128, 64×64 otherwise.
3. Pass 1 (non-causal blocks): iterate $0 \to (\lfloor m/BLOCK_N\rfloor)\cdot BLOCK_N$, do $qk = Q K^T$ without any mask, online softmax with $\exp_2$.
4. Pass 2 (boundary blocks): iterate the remainder up to $(m+1)\cdot BLOCK_M$ with tl.where causal mask.
5. Divide acc by l_i and store; saves a multiply per element and removes the mask in ~half the iterations.
diff_from_baseline: Dao, ICLR 2024 — FlashAttention-2. Two-pass causal splitting + per-headdim block tuning + fused softmax scale; the de-facto fused attention baseline before FA3.

name: FlashAttention-3 (Triton-approx)
tagline: Two-pass causal + fused scale + Triton autotuner with software pipelining (num_stages, num_warps) approximating FA3 GEMM-softmax overlap.
pseudocode:
1. Wrapper fuses sm_scale·log2 e into Q exactly like FA2.
2. `@triton.autotune` over 8 configs of (BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N, num_stages, num_warps), keyed on (seqlen, BLOCK_DMODEL, IS_CAUSAL).
3. Software pipelining via num_stages=3-4 prefetches the next K/V tile during the current matmul.
4. Same two-pass causal split as FA2: a non-causal pass (no tl.where) and a boundary pass (with tl.where).
5. Hopper-specific TMA / warp-specialised async copies are not exposed in Triton, so async overlap is approximated through staged pipelining and larger tiles.
diff_from_baseline: Shah, Bikshandi, Zhang, Thakkar, Ramani & Dao, NeurIPS 2024 — FlashAttention-3. True FA3 uses Hopper warp-specialisation + TMA + FP8; this Triton baseline approximates the asynchronous GEMM-softmax pipelining via num_stages and aggressive autotuning.
